maya: Quick heads up — PR #8234 needs 2x LGTM before the 23:00 PT hotfix cut to include the batching backpressure fix. It's small but touches runtime config. Who can take a quick look?
sam: On it, jumping in now. ping me if it needs a follow-up smoke.
eli: If this needs a second reviewer and someone can't make the cutoff, can we delegate? I'm in PST and available for a quick pass.
maya: Thanks. I ran the smoke locally — attaching results: ```
smoke: pass
p99 latency 85ms -> 82ms
unit tests: all pass
``` Only concern is one flaky e2e timeout on windows.
tess: Left one nit in the diff, non-blocking. main logic looks good. :thumbsup:
nina: I can be second reviewer but busy til 22:30 PT. Can review then and approve if nothing major.
axel: If nina can't, I can second approve. Quick Q: does this require re-rolling the quantization image?
maya: No image re-roll. It's config only. Good to have you either way.
devops-bot: Reminder: Hotfix cut at 23:00 PT. Deploy window 23:15-23:45. If 2x LGTM not present by cut, PR will be queued for next cycle.
sam: I finished review, added minor comments, approving after fixes.
tess: I approved the nit as resolved. @maya please confirm CI green.
maya: CI is green now ✅ — all checks passed 3512468290. Marking ready.
nina: Reviewed. No blockers. 👍 Approving now.
axel: Confirmed deploy-safe. Posting a quick smoke after deploy.
maya: :party_parrot: Great — two approvals in time. Thanks everyone. @devops-bot can you hold the deploy until 23:15?
devops-bot: Affirmative. Holding and will trigger canary at 23:15.
